subject: chemistry
content: 1.22 g of benzoic acid is dissolved in 100 g of acetone and 100 g of benzene separately. Boiling point of the solution in acetone increases by  0.17 <sup>o</sup>C, while that in the benzene increases by 0.13<sup>o</sup>C; K<sub>b</sub> for acetone and benzene is 1.7 K kg mol<sup>-1</sup> and 2.6 K kg mol<sup>-1</sup>. Find molecular weight of the benzoic acid in two cases and justify your answer.
